text:
```yaml
name: Aliyun Docker Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Build for AMD64
        run: GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o xiaohongshu-mcp-amd64 .

      - name: Build for ARM64
        run: GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -o xiaohongshu-mcp-arm64 .

      - name: Login to Aliyun Container Registry
        run: echo "${{ secrets.ALIYUN_REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}" | docker login --username "${{ secrets.ALIYUN_REGISTRY_USERNAME }}" registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com --password-stdin

      - name: Push image for AMD64
        run: |
          docker tag xiaohongshu-mcp-amd64 registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp:latest-amd64
          docker push registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp:latest-amd64

      - name: Push image for ARM64
        run: |
          docker tag xiaohongshu-mcp-arm64 registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp:latest-arm64
          docker push registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/xpzouying/xiaohongshu-mcp:latest-arm64
```
